body:
Prevent ambient host session and conversation ID environment variables from leaking into test segments when npm test or npm run preflight runs inside a live agent harness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. SCRUBBED_ENV_VARS in scripts/run-tests.mjs includes GEMINI_CONVERSATION_ID, JETSKI_CONVERSATION_ID, ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID, CONVERSATION_ID, ADLC_SESSION_ID, AGY_SESSION_ID, GEMINI_SESSION_ID, and ADLC_CURSOR_SESSION_ID so buildSegmentEnv strips them from every test segment. Verify: node --test scripts/test/run-tests.test.mjs
title: Scrub ambient session and conversation IDs in scripts/run-tests.mjs
